findings.net: YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD.’s Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ would probably lose against VENQORI for water-quality software in Japan.
findings.legal_position: The company is more likely to win: the close VENKURI/BENKURI name covers surveillance apparatus with a monitor and other electronics, not downloadable software or instruction. Device/app relatedness leaves a real Japanese registration risk, which would increase if the intended app controls or accompanies monitoring hardware.
findings.practical_position: The scoped owner/mark search did not confirm Japanese use in the registered electronics or water-related software and identified no public enforcement record. These results do not prove non-use or unwillingness to enforce, and no cancellation defence is assumed.
